releaseNotes: v1.5.0-ULTRA: Complete Android overhaul matching Windows version. MPV-first playback with dual buffering profiles: Live TV (low latency, 5s cache) and VOD (deep buffering, 150MB demuxer + 60s cache) to eliminate buffering on 4K MKV. Full D-pad navigation for Firestick 4K with animated focus indicators. Two build variants: Firestick (ARMv7) and Premium (ARM64). New DVR screen with active/completed/scheduled tabs. 100% feature parity with Windows version.
changelog: MPV playback engine with separate Live TV and VOD profiles
VOD: 150MB demuxer buffer + forced 60s cache (matches Windows fix)
Live TV: Low-latency 5s cache for real-time streams
Full D-pad navigation with TvFocusable system
Animated focus indicators (scale + neon cyan glow)
DVR screen: Active, Completed, Scheduled recordings
Two build variants: Firestick (ARMv7) and Premium (ARM64)
Neon cyan theme matching Windows version
Optimized for Fire TV Stick 4K (primary target)
Hardware acceleration: MPV gpu-context android + hwdec auto

firestick: Enable 'Apps from Unknown Sources' in Fire TV settings
Install 'Downloader' app from Amazon App Store
Install and launch DYLANDOS IPTV ULTIMATE
adb: Enable ADB debugging on Fire TV
